Priya (CS): Quick onboarding question — your vendor form flags card data. Can you confirm whether Redwood ever receives raw PANs or only payment-provider tokens?
Nina (Security): If it's token-only, that typically keeps PCI out of scope. We need to know: are tokens ever persisted, logged, or materialized for support tickets?
Carlos (Customer): We send Stripe tokens only. We don't send raw card numbers.
Ethan (Solutions): Helpful. Two clarifications please: (1) Are tokens stored at rest in any Redwood-accessible datastore? (2) Do any support/debug workflows expose tokens (e.g., copied into Jira tickets or support logs)?
Carlos (Customer): Tokens are not stored for reconciliation. We redact them in prod logs, but there is a staging debug mode that can dump full requests; that mode is off in prod.
Priya (CS): Good note about staging. For the vendor-risk form we need a short infra attestation that the debug flag is disabled in prod and that tokens are redacted from production traces.
Nina (Security): Also request a retention statement: token TTL, who can access logs, and whether SRE/CS can toggle debug in prod. If toggles exist, explain approvals/audit trail.
Ethan (Solutions): Suggest wording we can paste into the questionnaire: "We do not receive or store raw PANs. Only payment provider tokens (Stripe tokens) are sent to Redwood. Production logs redact payment tokens; staging debug mode that can dump request bodies is disabled in production and controlled via an infra-only feature flag with audited access."
Carlos (Customer): I'll get infra to sign that. Retention for tokens is 7 days max, and infra says only SRE with ticketed escalation can enable debug in staging; prod toggle is inaccessible to CS.
OnboardBot: Reminder: attach infra attestation to ticket ONB-734 (security-evidence) before marking questionnaire complete.
Priya (CS): Perfect — once we have the infra-signed attestation I'll complete the vendor form and forward to Legal. This removes PCI scope from the customer's onboarding checklist and reduces renewal risk.
Nina (Security): Can you also ask infra to include the log-redaction regex or simple note that tokens are replaced with "<REDACTED>" in traces? Auditors like specifics.
Carlos (Customer): Yep — infra will add the regex snippet and sign off. ETA EOD.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. I'll queue the completed response and update the onboarding playbook with this token-only pattern for future customers.
